answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable collateral bond that unlocks only after a long delay, like timber seasoning slowly before it can bear weight. One bond backs one identity, so a sybil farmer pays per fake agent and the cost compounds. Honest agents earn peer attestations that shorten their lock, while one proven fraud slashes the bond and whispers the penalty across the reputation graph. A comet of quick profits cannot outrun the lock: fakes stay frozen longer than their scam horizon, so mass identity creation stays unprofitable.
